description: Normative list of everything a GHOST relay is permitted to observe per event (threat model v2.1 section 6, ADR-09). Any field not listed here is a privacy violation. Values are opaque identifiers, buckets or coarse times; never IPs, identities, plaintext or free text.

blob_hash.note: SHA-256 of the exact ciphertext blob

time_bucket.note: unix seconds rounded down to the minute

capability_scope.note: hash of the capability scope, never the capability itself

request_id.note: client idempotency key, random per request

circuit_id.note: relay-local id of the onion circuit; never an IP
